evidence.field: Summary; Source; Permission; Licensing; file history
evidence.text: Commons identifies 牛-seal.svg as a modern vector depiction of 牛 in Shuowen seal-script style. It attributes the picture to Academia Sinica Xiaoxuetang record 27.725B and lists an image record at Chinese Etymology; the page states CC0 1.0 and records file revisions in 2009 and 2018. This modern rendering can illustrate the seal form, but does not establish the shape or date of earlier inscriptional forms.
evidence.title: File:牛-seal.svg

evidence.text: The page groups examples under oracle-bone, bronze (including a citation to 集成04132), Chu manuscript, small-seal and Shuowen headings. Its explanation says the graph emphasizes the ox’s head and horns and originally referred to the animal. The inspected text does not date the individual specimens.
evidence.title: 漢字「牛」：字形演變

search_audit.query: 牛-seal.svg Wikimedia Commons 牛 seal script CC0; 牛 字形演變 甲骨 金文 小篆 Academia Sinica
search_audit.outcome: Opened both the exact Commons description page and Academia Sinica character-evolution page. Verified the seal-style graphic’s identity and stated license, and checked the paleographic page’s form labels and account. Commons page also exposed the original image link: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/c0/%E7%89%9B-seal.svg.

gaps: The seal image is a modern vector rendering, not an ancient artifact photograph; its source page does not date the represented specimen.

Academia Sinica lists form classes and a bronze corpus reference but does not date individual 牛 examples or establish the earliest securely dated attestation. The queried pages do not provide a dated chronology of later senses.
No components, sound role, graphic corruption, or competing formation account are established by this limited verification.

items.period: Small-seal script style; the vector file was revised in 2009 and 2018. The represented form itself is not individually dated by the file page.
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 牛 in Shuowen seal-script style. It illustrates a later seal form, not an excavated early specimen.
items.alt: Black seal-script rendering of 牛 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons description page identifies the graph and style, names source records, and states CC0 1.0. It offers a sourced later form to accompany the account of the graph’s development without treating it as proof of the earliest form.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication, as stated on the Commons file page.

limitations.text: The selected image is a modern vector rendering of a seal-script form, not an ancient artifact photograph; neither it nor the inspected evolution page establishes dates for individual specimens or the earliest securely dated 牛 graph.
